alex kim: Quick heads-up — I ran a set of microbenchmarks on the continuous batcher this AM. Trying a different batch seeding heuristic to reduce long-sequence queue buildup.

maya rao: nice. what did you change?

alex kim: Instead of simple FIFO + length bias, I tried a sliding-window seed priority that prefers small requests during the initial batch-formation window but still guarantees periodic long-seq insertion.

lina chen: can you paste the config?

alex kim: Sure, pasted below from the canary config:
```
batcher.window_ms = 18
batcher.max_batch_tokens = 4096
batcher.seed_priority = "windowed-shortbias"  # new heuristic
batcher.long_insertion_interval = 200ms
queue.policy = "tenant-aware-proportional"
```

samir patel: Interesting. Did you change token budget targets per tenant too?

alex kim: Kept global targets the same for now. I added a tenant smoothing factor so big tenants don't hog every seed slot. It's basically: allocated_slots = floor(global_slots * tenant_weight) with a min guaranteed slot.

opsbot: deploy-bot: canary deploy started for `batcher/seed-priority/v2` on pool gpu-pool-3 at 2198765440

maya rao: What telemetry are you looking at? p95/p99 overall can hide long/short disparities.

alex kim: Exactly. I instrumented per-seq-length buckets + per-tenant fairness index. Query I used (pseudo):
```
select tenant, seq_len_bucket, p50_latency, p95_latency, kv_hit_rate, batches_formed
from telemetry.batcher
where deploy = 'batcher/seed-priority/v2'
group by tenant, seq_len_bucket
```

lina chen: What did you see?

alex kim: Short summary: overall p95 dropped 6% and throughput stable. But two medium tenants (T-42, T-19) had a sustained p99 increase for seq_len > 1024. KV hit-rate for those tenants also dropped ~3ppt during warm-up windows.

tony g: That smells like KV warm-up bias + kernel-selection thrash. If long sequences get delayed they miss their KV locality and then choose a slower kernel path.

samir patel: Any evidence of kernel rebinds in the logs?

alex kim: Yes, saw repeated kernel selection logs for the same model shard within seconds: `kernel-select: model=redwood/xyz quant=4bit -> kernel=a_v2` then `-> kernel=b_affine` rapidly. That correlated with the p99 spikes.

maya rao: Hmm. Could be the batcher is oscillating between merging short requests (fast kernel) and periodically letting a long request in which forces a different kernel and flushes caches.

lina chen: Do you have a timeline + concrete metrics for the two tenants? We can run an A/B with kernel pinning for long sequences.

alex kim: Timeline: canary start 2198765440, anomaly window 2198765460-2198765485. Snapshot metrics (simplified):
- global p95: 142ms -> 133ms after change
- tenant T-42 p99 (seq>1024): 2.1s -> 3.7s during anomaly
- kv_hit_rate T-42: 84.5% -> 81.2% (drop)

devrel-kate: Is eviction churn higher? maybe the new seed bias causes KV entries to cycle differently.

alex kim: eviction rate up ~12% for those tenants. Also saw increased `kv-prefetch-miss` counters.

samir patel: Proposed quick experiments:
1) kernel pin for long sequences (pin to stable kernel) on a single canary host for T-42, T-19
2) increase long_insertion_interval to 300ms for 5 mins to reduce oscillation
3) add a short grace period after kernel switch to prefer same-kernel batches (kernel-hint sticky)

maya rao: +1 to (1) and (3). We should avoid changing tenant budgets yet. Also add trace id to kernel-select logs for correlation.

opsbot: deploy-bot: applied kernel-pin experiment to host gpu-12 for tenants [T-42,T-19] at 2198765472

lina chen: I can run a targeted perf profile on gpu-12. Will add a JFR-like capture and ETA ~30m.

alex kim: Thanks. I'll also flip on `batcher.debug_window_hist` to gather per-window composition.

devrel-kate: One more thought — our queue.policy has a tenant-aware proportional mode. Maybe it needs a small randomness seed per tenant to avoid deterministic phase alignment across tenants.

samir patel: good call. jittering seed offsets could break pathological alignment. Add to TODO.

maya rao: Action items:
- alex: collect full traces and link to telemetry dashboard (due 2198765495)
- lina: profile gpu-12 (ongoing)
- samir: implement kernel-hint sticky prototype (branch)
- devrel-kate: add jitter to tenant seed offsets (small PR)

alex kim: I'll post results in this thread when I have the trace + dashboard links. thanks all :thumbsup:
